readme: Dated historic evidence only. Does not replace July 2026 UNDP latest affected counts. Do not add between time periods.

undp_south_2026_04.title: Building-Level Damage Assessment: South Lebanon (Issue 1, June 2026)
undp_south_2026_04.validation: office-based visual validation; no field verification
undp_south_2026_04.caveat: Published listed hotspot destroyed building counts, not an exhaustive cadastral census; partially covered areas likely undercount. Do not compare as a common 2026-06 snapshot.

undp_beirut_mount_2026_04.caveat: Only assessed Beirut and Mount Lebanon area; targeted apartments are separate and cannot be summed as destroyed buildings.

coverage.reporting_note: Other cadastres can have damage that is NOT REPORTED in these printed tables. No record must never be interpreted as zero damage.
